description: This source file defines an enumeration for different database types within the Fineract project, specifically MySQL and PostgreSQL, along with utility methods for checking the database type.

classes.name: DatabaseType
classes.description: An enum representing supported database types with utility methods to identify the type.

methods.name: isMySql
methods.description: Checks if the database type is MySQL.

methods.name: isPostgres
methods.description: Checks if the database type is PostgreSQL.
